title: Half-lap art frame
description: Four frame members with complementary half-laps and a rear artwork rabbet. Adjust the artwork size, overlap and joinery, or separate the parts to inspect the joints.
notes: Converted from the supplied Onshape FeatureScript. Dimensions are in inches; displayed bounds and STL exports are in millimetres. Defaults fit 30⅜ × 21⁵⁄₁₆ inch artwork with ¼ inch overlap at each edge. The rails retain the front half of each lap; the stiles retain the back half. The rear rabbet starts at Z=0. Clearance enlarges the rear pocket without changing the visible opening. Each physical member has its own color; select a single part for a separate STL. The dimension summary gives two identical rail blanks and two identical stile blanks before machining.
